use_when: user requests a complete Official Account article to be written and delivered
user requests title, cover, or compliance work on an article they are writing
user requests layout rendering into Official Account HTML
user requests saving an article into their own draft box
user asks which step of the writing flywheel comes next
target_state_gates: The user's stated target state decides how far along this route to travel; ask when it is unstated.
Target state 'a finished draft text' stops at the writing Skill; nothing downstream runs.
Target state 'laid-out Official Account HTML' or 'the post sitting in my own draft box' travels to wechat-article-pipeline.
wechat-article-pipeline and wechat-draft-publish write into the user's own Official Account backend (draft only, never mass send), so they need an explicit target state, not an inferred one.

use_when: user requests public article discovery or keyword search without QR login
user requests reading, like, recommendation, or comment metrics
user requests account analysis, trend research, or topic ideation

precedence: Evaluate the highest-priority matching route first.

Intent to write, lay out, or deliver the user's own article selects doubaoya-authoring-delivery; how far along that route to travel is decided by the target state the user stated, not by a fixed number of hops.
Explicit interaction-metric intent selects doubaoya-cloud-public-data; those metrics only exist on the cloud data capabilities.
Research routes feed the authoring route: once a topic is chosen, hand the work forward rather than treating a search result as the deliverable, unless the user asked only for the research.

request_signals: stop at the drafted article text when the user asked for the draft box
stop at the banned-word check when the user asked for laid-out HTML
deliver markdown only when the user asked for a publishable post
write into the draft box when the user only asked for the article text
forbidden_misroutes.reason: Route by the user's target state in both directions: stopping at the text when they asked for a post in their draft box strands the work, and writing into their Official Account when they only asked for the text is an unrequested side effect.
Cloud discovery skills must not replace the user-approved local archive workflow.
